title: Neurosterix nabs $105M, recruits Karuna veterans for schizophrenia push
snippet: Addex Therapeutics spinout Neurosterix will use the series B funds to advance an oral drug targeting M4, a muscarinic receptor also targeted by BMS’ Cobenfy, which introduced a new mechanism for treating schizophrenia with its 2024 approval.

title: FDA’s commissioner voucher program reportedly shuttered ahead of Senate vote on Overton
snippet: In advance of a Senate vote on Heidi Overton as the next FDA commissioner, the agency has shelved the Commissioner's National Priority Voucher program introduced by former leader Marty Makary, Reuters reported Thursday.

title: Biopharma layoffs rise YOY in October but sharply trend down for 2026
snippet: October marked the first time this year there was an increase in both the number of biotech and pharma companies trimming their workforces and the number of affected employees when compared to 2025. Still, it’s highly unlikely 2026 layoffs will come close to matching the downsizing seen last year.
